facts.fact: UNHCR Senegal states that on lodging an asylum application with the Commission Nationale d'Eligibilite in Dakar, the applicant receives a recepisse valid six months and renewable, which lets them move freely in Senegal pending the decision.
facts.system: Commission Nationale d'Eligibilite (CNE) asylum application and recepisse

note: Donor humanitarian initiative with no registration, identity document or digital service stated.
Donor allocation table; no refugee registration or digital inclusion statement.

facts.fact: Senegal decree 2025-1560 of 17 September 2025 sets out the introduction of a biometric ID card and travel document for recognised refugees and stateless people, issued by the Interior Ministry with the CNGRA coordinating.
facts.system: biometric refugee identity card and travel document

systems.system: Biometric refugee/stateless ID card and travel document

note: The page says refugee cards are issued with delays and asylum claims register only in Dakar, but states no number registered or documented and nothing on SIM, mobile money or digital ID access.

facts.fact: Decree 2025-1559 provides that asylum applications may be filed electronically, receive a receipt and are recorded in the refugee and stateless database, with a refugee identity card issued on admission.

note: Nothing on refugees or displaced people.
